item.title: Peak XV announces $1.3B across three new funds for exceptional founders in India, APAC and beyond
item.description: Peak XV has announced the closing of $1.3 billion in new capital commitments across its India Seed, India Venture, and APAC funds.

item.title: Maybank foresees robust pipeline for Malaysia’s renewable energy contracts
item.description: The project pipeline for utility-scale solar projects remain robust with the upcoming rollout of Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme (CRESS) and large scale solar 6 (LSS6) projects, Maybank Investment Bank said Monday.

item.title: From wire fraud to AI impersonation: Rethinking security architecture in PropTech marketplaces
item.description: Proptech platforms that embed trust as a product feature, enforcing identity checks, payment integrity, and content authenticity within their core architecture, will not just reduce loss; they will strengthen user confidence, compliance posture, and long-term ecosystem credibility.

item.title: LookOut: How two vulnerabilities in Google Looker could put enterprise data at risk
item.description: As organizations rely more heavily on integrated platforms, those platforms naturally become concentrated points of failure. The more systems a tool connects to, the greater the blast radius if something goes wrong.

item.title: From decarbonization to de-plasticization: Why Asia’s next climate deals will be blue
item.description: How technology, data, and urban prevention infrastructure are turning ocean health into the next scalable climate investment theme in Asia

item.title: SoftBank joins QAI Ventures to build Singapore quantum hub
item.description: QAI Ventures, the Switzerland-based investor and ecosystem builder in quantum and advanced computing technologies, is launching a specialized industry cluster in Singapore to accelerate the commercialization of quantum-classical hybrid computing, backed by strategic partnerships with SoftBank Corp. and HorizonX.

item.title: TruFin secures strategic investment led by Singapore-based SC Ventures
item.description: Global fintech firm TruFin has announced a strategic investment led by Singapore-based SC Ventures, the venture building and investment arm of Standard Chartered, with participation from FalconX and Road Capital.

item.title: U Mobile inks three-year 5G wholesale contract with Telekom Malaysia
item.description: U Mobile, a Malaysia-based 5G network provider, has signed a three-year 5G wholesale contract with Telekom Malaysia Berhad (TM), following a structured evaluation process.

item.title: Indonesia launches digital innovation hub to accelerate digital solutions
item.description: Bank Indonesia (BI) has initiated the Indonesia Digital Innovation Hub (PIDI) in collaboration with the Indonesia Financial Services Authority (OJK), Indonesia Payment System Association (ASPI), Indonesia FinTech Association (Aftech), Indonesia Money Market and Foreign Exchange Market Association (APUVINDO) and Indonesian Banking Development Institute (LPPI).

item.title: Singtel’s Digital InfraCo accelerates sovereign AI innovations with Center of Excellence for Applied AI with NVIDIA
item.description: Singtel’s Digital InfraCo announced Tuesday the launch of a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Applied AI with NVIDIA as part of the group’s strategy to build a strong, trusted artificial intelligence (AI) ecosystem for Singapore.
